name: Ventaari Brightwish
summary: In Thendal Village, Ventaari Brightwish welcomes travelers from across Azeroth and offers them The Gift of Skysight.

sections.title: A Dweller of Thendal Village
sections.body: Ventaari Brightwish welcomes newcomers to Thendal Village on Zephras Isle. As a Skyborne resident, she helps visitors from both the Alliance and the Horde. Through The Gift of Skysight, Ventaari introduces them to her people's traditions.

faq.answer: Ventaari Brightwish lives in Thendal Village on Zephras Isle. She greets visitors and offers The Gift of Skysight.

faq.q: Where can I find Ventaari Brightwish?
faq.answer: Find Ventaari Brightwish in Thendal Village on Zephras Isle.

faq.q: Is Ventaari hostile to the Horde or Alliance?
faq.answer: No. Ventaari Brightwish speaks with adventurers from both the Alliance and the Horde.

angles.text: As a Skyborne in Thendal Village, Ventaari Brightwish helps visitors learn about the culture and ways of Zephras Isle.
